Name: Auto-change Outfits
Author: ahomiepassingby
Description:
[center][color=#F08787][size=4]Tired of always having to adjust your outfits manually to match the vibe?[/size][/color]
[b][size=5]This mod can help! ✨[/size][/b][/center][size=3]

[/size][b][size=4][code]TL;DR: Read the Guide.txt inside the mod folder for setup instructions - in case you're too lazy to read the description.
[/code][/size][/b][size=3]
[/size]
A [s]very simple[/s] mod that allows you to [b][i]auto-change your clothes [/i][/b]when the time comes, using your custom saved outfits from the [i]Hand Mirror[/i] (FS). [b]Works in multiplayer[/b] as long as all of you have the same clothing mods to see each other's outfits.

[quote][b][size=3]First,[/size][/b] you need to set up your clothes and save them. Use the following names when saving:
[b][i]*Basic:[/i][/b]
- [i]Daily1:[/i] Your daily outfit.
[i]- Winter1: [/i]Your winter outfit.
- [i]Pyjama1:[/i] Your home pyjama.
- [i]Raincoat1:[/i] Your rainy-day outfit.
- [i]Snowwear1:[/i] Your snow-day outfit.
- [i]Beach1:[/i] Your beach outfit.
- [i]Wedding1:[/i] Your wedding dress/suit.
- [i]Cave1: [/i]Your outfit when entering caves.
[b][i]*Seasonal:[/i][/b]
- [i]Spring1:[/i] Your spring outfit.
- [i]Summer1:[/i] Your summer outfit.
- [i]Fall1: [/i]Your fall outfit.
[b][i]*Seasonal Pyjamas:[/i][/b]
- [i]Pyspring1:[/i] Your spring home pyjama.
- [i]Pysummer1:[/i] Your summer home pyjama.
- [i]Pyfall1: [/i]Your fall home pyjama.
- [i]Pywinter1: [/i]Your winter home pyjama.
[b][i]*Seasonal Rain Clothes:[/i][/b]
- [i]Rspring1:[/i] Your spring rainy-day outfit.
- [i]Rsummer1:[/i] Your summer rainy-day outfit.
- [i]Rfall1:[/i] Your fall rainy-day outfit.
[i]- Rwinter1:[/i] Your winter rainy-day outfit (if using Rain totem).
[b][i]*Matching Clothes in rainy/snowy weather:[/i][/b]
 [b] ﻿**Casual Raincoat**[/b]
- [i]Rindoors1:[/i] Your indoor clothes match with the outdoor raincoat.
 [b] ﻿**Seasonal Raincoat**[/b]
- [i]Rinspring1:[/i] Your indoor clothes match with the outdoor spring raincoat.
- [i]Rinsummer1:[/i] Your indoor clothes match with the outdoor summer raincoat.
- [i]Rfall1:[/i] Your indoor clothes match with the outdoor fall raincoat.
- [i]Rinwinter1:[/i] Your indoor clothes match with the outdoor winter raincoat.
 [b] ﻿**Snow Clothes**[/b]
- [i]Snindoors1:[/i] Your indoor clothes match with the outdoor snowwear.
[b][i]*Seasonal Beach-wear:[/i][/b]
[i]- Bspring1:[/i] Your spring beach outfit.
[i]- Bsummer1:[/i] Your summer beach outfit.
[i]- Bfall1:[/i] Your fall beach outfit.
[i]- Bwinter1:[/i] Your winter beach outfit.
[b][i]*Seasonal Cave Outfits:[/i][/b]
- [i]Cspring1:[/i] Your spring cave outfit.
-[i] Csummer1: [/i]Your summer cave outfit.
- [i]Cfall1: [/i]Your fall cave outfit.
- [i]Cwinter1:[/i] Your winter cave outfit.
[b][i]*Festivals:[/i][/b]
- [i]Egg:[/i] Your outfit for The Egg Festival.
- [i]Flowerdance:[/i] Your outfit for The Flower Dance.
- [i]Luau: [/i]Your outfit for The Luau.
- [i]Jellies:[/i] Your outfit for The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies.
- [i]SVfair: [/i]Your outfit for The Stardew Valley Fair.
- [i]Halloween:[/i] Your outfit for The Spirit's Eve.
- [i]Icefes:[/i] Your outfit for The Festival of Ice.
- [i]Xmas:[/i]  Your outfit for The Feast of the Winter Star.
[b][i]*Supported other mods:[/i][/b]
[b] ﻿**Polyamory Sweet/Free Love**[/b]
- (Numbering) [i]Wedding1,...[/i]
- [i]Wedding_{{spouse}}:[/i] Name after your spouse. 
  > Ex: Wedding_Sebastian
[b] ﻿**Happy Birthday**[/b]
- [i]Birthday:[/i] Your birthday outfit.
[b] ﻿**Weather Wonders**[/b]
- [i]Umbrella1:[/i] Outfit for dangerous weather - hailstorm, acid rain.
- [i]Fold1:[/i] Fold your umbrella before getting indoors.
- [i]Sand1:[/i] Outfit for Sandstorm on Desert (WW beta).

When you have [u]more than 1 outfit[/u] and want it to change randomly day by day, open the config (mod options), enable exactly the outfits you want to randomize, and set the quantity you have. Then, name your outfits in sequence (Daily1, Daily2, Daily3,...).
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Yq2SsMvk/Screenshot-2025-10-12-011830.png[/img]

[size=3][b]Second[/b][/size] thing you should do is head to the mod options, because I set almost config to false. You should open it and set as you want.[/quote]



[b][size=3]Currently Implemented Changes:[/size][/b]
[quote]- Wear [i][b]pyjamas [/b][/i]at the farmhouse in the early morning (before 7 a.m.) and at bedtime (after 10 p.m.)
- Wear a [i][b]raincoat [/b][/i]when outdoors on rainy days. If indoors, switch back to daily/seasonal outfit. 
- On rainy/snowy days, if you're at the farmhouse, you’ll stay in [i][b]pyjamas[/b][/i].
- Wear [i][b]beach outfits[/b][/i] when you're at the beach or in Ginger Island.
- Set your [i][b]wedding dress/suit[/b][/i] for your wedding. If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]FreeLove[/url]﻿, you can set more than 1 wedding outfit.
- When none of the above conditions match, your outfit will revert to [b][i]daily outfits[/i][/b].
- Or, if you prefer to wear[i] [b]seasonal outfits[/b][/i], your clothes will automatically change as the seasons do.
- If you use Seasonal Outfits, your [b][i]outfits in the Desert[/i][/b] are your summer outfits.
- You can now wear some clothes to "go against" the [b][i]snow in winter[/i][/b]. When indoors, change back to your winter outfit (or daily outfit if you’re not using Seasonal Outfits).
- If you wanna become the center at the [i][b]festival[/b][/i], then shine bright!
- Change your clothes when entering the [b][i]caves[/i][/b] to keep your beautiful outfit from getting dirty with mud or monster gunk.
- Dress up on your [i][b]birthday[/b][/i]. But if your birthday is on rainy/snowy day, your birthday outfit is only show indoors.
- [i][b]Wedding[/b][/i] is your special day, so except when entering the cave, your outfit will hardly change. [i][b]Festivals[/b][/i] and [i][b]birthday[/b][/i] are also special - your outfit won’t change as long as you’re in the Valley.
- Now you can have your outfits matching with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Weather Wonders[/url]﻿. Furthermore, it has some extra outfits for [b][i]special weathers[/i][/b].[/quote]
I don't know if anyone still wants to use Daily Outfits, but I'll keep it anyway. Whoever needs it, needs it *winks*

[b][size=3]Noted[/size][/b] that I just temporarily call "rain clothes" is raincoat, you can wear whatever you want. An umbrella, for example? 
And you don’t need to set up every single outfit. Like, if you don’t want your outfit to change at the beach, simply skip it. It's totally okay.

[b][size=3]For now,[/size][/b] I only use [b]SVE [/b]as an expansion mod, so this mod [color=#08CB00]is compatible[/color] with it. But it doesn't mean that my mod is incompatible with others, it's just when you reach certain conditions in those maps, the outfits may not change. If you want any other expansion mod to be compatible as well, you can suggest to me and I will consider.

[b][size=3]Translations:[/size] [/b]Feel free to translate this mod into any language — no need to ask for permission. Just make sure to credit the original mod and link to this page. I really appreciate your effort in helping more players enjoy this mod.
